STAGE: review of four proposals against the frozen bundle (rubric rank-2026-10-v1). No workspace files needed; every proposal's bundle is identical in content (E1-E11 behavioural, E12-E14 geometric) so discrimination must come from how each design consumes the shared measurements.

What I read and the evidence used:
- E6 (width-20 beam survival, 57439 test rows): l1_br (hyperbolic-only SID) recall@10 0.04671 with gold prefix alive at depth 1/2/3/4 = 1.000/1.000/1.000/0.068; l1_br_euclid 0.06207 with 1.000/0.829/0.161/0.085; l1_only 0.06233; resample 0.06363; successor_geodesic_coarse 0.05500; successor_geodesic_coarse_v2 0.05463; tangent_successor_residual 0.05500. => strong/restructured hyperbolic distance in the baseline has COLLAPSED the deep prefix (depth-4 survival 0.068) and lost ~0.016 recall vs the Euclidean variant; successor-anchored residual/geodesic variants sit at ~0.055, i.e. BELOW the Euclidean 0.06207.
- E7 (teacher-forced NLL): l1_br T4 NLL 9.03 (degenerate deep prefix) vs l1_br_euclid T2/T3/T4 3.22/4.36/1.23. Confirms the failure mode of geometry-dominant SIDs and shows the useful operating point is depth-2/3 prefix survival, which the euclid variant retains (0.829/0.161).
- E8 (first-level capacity ceiling on frozen Stage1 vectors): anchor/target in one of K clusters K=16 0.3106 (neg 0.1352), K=32 0.2164, K=64 0.1547, K=256 0.0822 (neg 0.0129) => the binding lever is COARSE-prefix co-location of behavioural neighbours; at the frozen K=256 the achievable first-level co-location is only ~8%, so a mechanism must act on level-1 provenance, and small-K behaviour gains are where the headroom is.
- E11: baseline same_first_prefix_rate 0.0907 vs permuted null 0.067 => baseline SIDs barely beat chance on prefix sharing of behavioural pairs, so headroom exists but is small in absolute terms.
- E9: positive shares a successor cohort with its anchor 0.9291 vs 0.8871 for fixed negatives (profile beats all ten negatives in 0.5898 of pairs) => the successor signal is real but only weakly discriminative; a huge behaviour forcing term would be over-reach.
- E5: successor mass skew, top-1 mass 0.4375 (lowest-entropy quintile, support 2.77) vs 0.0543 (highest, support 44.3) => frames/weights derived from per-item successor concentration are legitimate, but most items live in the diffuse regime, so per-item warps must degrade to (near) identity there or they damage reconstruction.
- E10: 118315 train-only edges, mean out-degree 5.45 => successor sets are small; anchors/SVD factors of such a sparse row-normalised matrix will be popularity-driven, as SUCCFRAME-MOEB-RQ's own risk list concedes.

Provisional ordering produced and the reasoning behind each placement:
1) STATECELL-MARGIN-RQ - the only proposal whose behaviour term is (a) defined over the hierarchy's own alphabet (successor occupancy of each level code), which is exactly the quantity E8 shows is the binding constraint at coarse level and E11 shows is barely above null in the baseline, and (b) explicitly bounded by a DERIVED scale (tau_l = median nearest-code squared distance at level init) so it cannot override reconstruction; it therefore avoids the l1_br collapse documented in E6/E7. Cost 5-15% and no tuned constant.
2) succframe-warp-rq - strongest per-item adaptivity and fully derived (alpha_i from eigenvalue share, matching the E5 heterogeneity), shared across all levels; but its stated distance is monotone in ||W_i ch||, so the artanh/curvature carries no extra assignment

information and the mechanism is effectively a per-item Mahalanobis warp plus Mobius prefix composition; full-rank warping is the class of change that E6/E7 show has already cost 0.016 recall (l1_br 0.0467) rather than gained it.
3) beh-aniso-poincare-rq - self-declared mildness (beta in [0,1] caps stretch at sqrt(2)) and the same monotone-artanh inertness; E6 puts mild geometry-only variants at ~0.055 vs 0.06207 for the Euclidean assignment, so the expected effect is inside seed noise, and its tangent Frechet codebook update adds optimisation risk.
4) SUCCFRAME-MOEB-RQ - the nearest existing analogues in E6 (tangent_successor_residual 0.05500, successor_geodesic_coarse 0.05500/0.05463) are precisely "successor-anchored/geodesic residual path" mechanisms and they scored below l1_br_euclid; it freezes a popularity-driven rank-d SVD anchor before training (most items have <2 successors, E5 bin-1 support 2.77), and it replaces the reconstruction loss with geodesic squared, a confound its own risk list admits a single run cannot separate.
NOTE: I am ranking the coupling plausibility for a single-run Stage-3 test_recall@10 > 0.065, NOT SID-quality diagnostics (not a criterion per the contract).
Still open: nothing to read further; final answer block to be appended.

FINAL ANSWER (complete, stands on its own). Ranking of the four proposals against the frozen bundle under rank-2026-10-v1, best first, each grounded in the evidence I used, plus the reviewer objection.

RANK: STATECELL-MARGIN-RQ | position=1 | reason=E8 shows the binding constraint is coarse-prefix co-location of behavioural neighbours (K=16 0.3106 vs negatives 0.1352, but only 0.0822 at the frozen K=256) and E11 shows the baseline barely beats chance on prefix sharing (0.0907 vs permuted null 0.067); this is the only proposal that scores successor OCCUPANCY of each level code (exactly that quantity) as a margin capped by a derived scale tau_l = median nearest-code squared distance, so it can move level-1 membership without overriding reconstruction or reproducing the hyperbolic collapse documented in E6/E7 (l1_br recall 0.04671, depth-4 prefix survival 0.068, T4 NLL 9.03).
RANK: succframe-warp-rq | position=2 | reason=its per-item warp strength alpha_i from the eigenvalue share of the successor second moment matches the measured heterogeneity in E5 (top-1 successor mass 0.4375 vs 0.0543 across entropy quintiles) and is fully derived with no tuned constant, but the metric is applied as artanh of a warped chord norm, so the curvature is monotone and adds no assignment information (the change is effectively a per-item Mahalanobis warp), and full-rank warping is the class of change that E6/E7 show already cost recall (l1_br 0.04671 vs l1_br_euclid 0.06207), so it must clear a higher bar than the bounded margin above.
RANK: beh-aniso-poincare-rq | position=3 | reason=its own risk list concedes beta in [0,1] caps the stretch at sqrt(2), and the distance is again a monotone artanh of an anisotropic quadratic form, so curvature carries no extra signal; against E6, where mild geometry-only variants sit at successor_geodesic_coarse 0.05500 and tangent_successor_residual 0.05500 versus 0.06207 for the Euclidean assignment, a mild gauge is most likely a no-op inside single-seed noise, and its tangent Frechet codebook update adds an optimisation risk the evidence gives no support for.
RANK: SUCCFRAME-MOEB-RQ | position=4 | reason=the closest existing analogues in E6 are precisely successor-anchored residual/geodesic-path mechanisms and they scored below the Euclidean variant (tangent_successor_residual 0.05500, successor_geodesic_coarse 0.05500, successor_geodesic_coarse_v2 0.05463 vs l1_br_euclid 0.06207); it freezes a rank-d SVD of a row-normalised transition matrix before training although E5/E10 show the successor graph is sparse and skew-driven (bin-1 support 2.77, mean out-degree 5.45), so most items get a near-origin, popularity-flavoured anchor, and it simultaneously replaces the reconstruction loss with geodesic squared, the confound its own risk list admits one run cannot separate.

OBJECTION: The mechanism I place first can plausibly be a near no-op: the measured behavioural signal is thin (E9 positive vs fixed-negative successor-cohort sharing 0.9291 vs 0.8871; E11 same-first-prefix 0.0907 vs null 0.067), so a margin bounded at one derived quantization unit may move level-1 membership without moving Stage-3 test_recall@10 past 0.065, and that outcome would be indistinguishable from seed noise in a programme that trains each candidate once and runs no ablation arm; add that tau_l is frozen at level initialisation from the initial encoder geometry and may no longer match the distance scale after 3000 epochs, and that if the run fails we c

annot tell whether the coupling, the derived constant, or the single seed is responsible.

STEP 1 — goal: check each of the four proposals against the five scope conditions (behaviour signal + curved operation + real coupling + testable switches + minimal spec) before ranking. Read: the four proposals in the round text and their frozen evidence bundles (b446d876c2868ce3 succframe-warp-rq, e73b8eb1c7c940d1 beh-aniso-poincare-rq, 3f0b0e98e5eaa49d STATECELL-MARGIN-RQ, 7c4d9919976eaa7c SUCCFRAME-MOEB-RQ).
Observed: all four name a train-only directed-transition signal (E1/E2 of each bundle), an explicit Poincare/Mobius/artanh operation acting inside the Stage-2 RQ quantizer (E12/E13 of each), and all four embed behaviour-off / geometry-off / both-on switches in the code. No proposal is out of scope on conditions 1-4.
Only gap found: beh-aniso-poincare-rq (bundle e73b8eb1c7c940d1, E2 truncated at "b_i = sum_j p_ij *") never gives an equation for beta_i or u_i in its own SPECIFICATION ("obtain beta_i in [0,1] and unit tangent direction u_i"), i.e. the defining quantity of its behaviour signal is undefined; that is a condition-5 minimal-specification weakness, not a scope return.
Open at this step: how to order the four on single-run probability of beating test Recall@10 = 0.065.

STEP 2 — goal: extract the decisive observed evidence that separates the four, since the judgement metric is Stage-3 test recall@10 and no ablation arm is run. Read: E6 (width-20 beam survival), E7 (teacher-forced per-position NLL), E8 (level-1 capacity ceiling), E9 (cohort-profile signal), E11 (same-first-prefix vs permuted null) in the frozen bundle, identical across the four bundles.
Observed and reasoning: (a) the best observed arms sit just under target — l1_br_euclid 0.06207, l1_only 0.06233, resample 0.06363 — and every arm that injects successor structure into quantisation is WORSE: l1_br 0.04671, successor_entropy 0.05122, successor_geodesic_coarse 0.05500, successor_geodesic_coarse_v2 0.05463, tangent_successor_residual 0.05500. Successor-driven SID shaping has repeatedly cost recall here. (b) E6/E7 locate the binding failure at depth: for l1_br_euclid gold prefix alive at depth 1/2/3/4 = 1.000/0.829/0.161/0.085 with T2/T3 NLL 3.22/4.36, i.e. level-1 is already resolved and depth-2/3 prefix resolution is what dies. (c) E8 gives the K=256 capacity ceiling: only 0.0822 of canonical pairs share a cluster at K=256 (0.1547 at K=64, 0.3106 at K=16), so forcing level-1 successor co-location at 256 codes fights the data. (d) E11 same-first-prefix 0.0907 vs permuted null 0.067 — little level-1 headroom. (e) E9 cohort signal is genuine but modest (0.9291 vs 0.8871 negative).
Consequence used for ranking: target the depth-2/3 residual path and keep level-1 assignment content-driven; penalise mechanisms whose main lever is level-1 successor collocation; penalise non-stationary or under-specified constructions. Open: final placement and the objection.

STEP 3 (final) — complete answer of this reviewer under selection policy rank-2026-10-v1. Grounding is the shared frozen bundle: E6 beam survival, E7 per-position NLL, E8 level-1 capacity ceiling, E9 cohort signal, E11 same-first-prefix vs null.

RANK: SUCCFRAME-MOEB-RQ | position=1 | reason=only proposal whose lever sits exactly on the observed failure: E6/E7 show level-1 is already solved (gold prefix alive 1.000, T1 NLL 0.00 for the best Euclidean arm l1_br_euclid 0.06207) while depth-2/3 prefix survival collapses (0.829/0.161/0.085) with T2/T3 NLL 3.22/4.36, and the frozen per-item anchor enters the Mobius recursion only after the level-1 argmin, so level-1 stays content-driven and levels 2-3 are re-expressed relative to the train-only successor region; anchors are frozen pre-Stage-2 (no per-epoch non-stationarity, unlike the warp frame), all constants are documented defaults (c=1, tau=atanh0.5, rho=0.5) so no sweep is implied, behaviour-off and geometry-off switches are exact and both needed for the recursion, and the <1% step cost keeps the single frozen-budget run intact.
RANK: succframe-warp-rq | position=2 | reason=best-specified successor-metric idea (determinant-one W_i from the measured successor second moment, alpha_i from the eigenvalue share, s_i clipped to [1/sqrt d, sqrt d], identity frame when |S_i|<2, codebooks/init/curvature untouched, beta and codebook settings inherited so no new tuned constant), but it warps the level-1 assignment as well, and E6's l1_br arm — the one that re-pointed level-1 membership by successor structure — landed at recall@10 0.04671 with gold depth-4 alive 0.068, while E8 caps how far 256 codes can follow successor directions; its per-epoch frame refresh from a moving encoder makes the metric non-stationary and it pushes ||q|| toward the r_max clip where artanh gradients saturate, and its 10-20% epoch-time estimate is the largest of the four.
RANK: beh-aniso-poincare-rq | position=3 | reason=fails the minimal-specification condition where the mechanism lives: the SPECIFICATION says only "obtain beta_i in [0,1] and unit tangent direction u_i" and bundle item E2 is truncated before the defining equation, so the successor concentration that sets the whole gauge is undefined; it also concedes its own stretch is bounded at sqrt(2) ("codes may barely move"), which against E6's best arm of 0.06207 makes a no-op short of 0.065 the likely single-run outcome, and the cohort evidence it leans on (E9: 0.9291 vs 0.8871) is the weakest signal in the bundle; it still keeps a genuine coupling (gauge inside the assignment distance and the tangent Frechet codebook update) and keeps E8's level-1 ceiling in view.
RANK: STATECELL-MARGIN-RQ | position=4 | reason=cleanest specification of the four (derived tau_l = median nearest-code squared distance, popularity-discounted p_ij, curvature from the 99th percentile encoder norm, K=(2 artanh0.9/s)^2, no tuned constant), but its core lever — shifting level-1 cells toward where the item's successors already sit — is the lever E6 already falsified on this data (l1_br, a level-1 behaviour boost, gave recall@10 0.04671 and gold depth-4 alive 0.068) and E8 shows there is no room for it at K=256 (only 0.0822 of canonical pairs share a cluster; E11 same-first-prefix 0.0907 vs null 0.067), so in one run the capped margin mostly risks reconstruction damage and early beam loss rather than reaching 0.065; the one-epoch-stale detached code cache adds oscillation risk that the no-a

blation policy cannot diagnose.

Objection (recorded): my first place is not a claim that the successor frame will work — the bundle's own history is that successor-structured SIDs have scored below the plain Euclidean arm every time they were tried; I rank SUCCFRAME-MOEB-RQ first only because it is the sole proposal that confines the successor lever to the depth where E6/E7 show prefixes actually die, and because a frozen anchor avoids the non-stationary metric that the two rival successor schemes introduce; the real falsifier in its single run is that most tail items have few train successors (E5 bin 1: support 2.8) so their anchors are near-origin and the gain, if any, will be concentrated in the head.
